title: Smart Data Models - ERA EVR - Vehicle
description: Vehicle (era:Vehicle's own definition, verbatim, in the source ontology): A specific vehicle or wagon able and allowed to operate over railway infrastructure.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Vehicle'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

hasCompositeBrakeBlockRetrofitted.description: Property. Indicates if a vehicle's composite brake block is retrofitted

inVehicleSeries.description: Relationship. Manufacturing series of a vehicle.

manufacturingCountry.description: Property. Indicates the country in which a vehicle or vehicle type is manufactured. Controlled-vocabulary value: IRI of a skos:Concept from the relevant ERA code list (see era-skos), not enumerated here as the source ontology leaves this range open.

manufacturingSerialNumber.description: Property. Manufacturing serial number as marked on the vehicle frame.

manufacturingYear.description: Property. Indicates the year in which a vehicle is manufactured. (xsd:gYear)

operationalRestriction.description: Property. Indicates an operational restriction of vehicle or wagon. Parking brake type (if the vehicle is fitted with it). Controlled-vocabulary value: IRI of a skos:Concept from ERA's 'Restrictions' SKOS concept scheme (http://data.europa.eu/949/concepts/restrictions/Restrictions), 7 concepts, enumerated below from era-skos.

vehicleECM.description: Relationship. Indicates the organization that is charge of maintenance. Target type (OrganisationRole) is published under the era-rinf standard.

vehicleKeeper.description: Relationship. Indicates the organization that owns/operated a vehicle or wagon. Target type (OrganisationRole) is published under the era-rinf standard.

vehicleKeeperMarking.description: Relationship. Indicates the Vehicle Keeper Marking (VKM) associated with a vehicle.

vehicleNumber.description: Property. European Vehicle Number. Numeric identification code as defined in Appendix 6 of Annex II of the EVR Regulation.

vehicleOwner.description: Relationship. Indicates the organization that owns a vehicle or wagon. Target type (OrganisationRole) is published under the era-rinf standard.

vehicleType.description: Relationship. Indicates the vehicle type of a specific vehicle or wagon. Target type (VehicleType) is published under the era-eratv standard.
